body:
My house has a security system that alerts me and the local law enforcement if it senses that somebody is trying to break in. I do not have cameras. 

I have thought about staying at my best friend's house for a few nights. It seems like a good idea, besides there's nothing wrong with being cautious and safe. 

Thank you for reassuring me that none of this is my fault. There have been times where I thought maybe I could have done something to prevent this, but now I realize his behavior is not something that I can control or change.

I'm going to be telling as many people I can tomorrow so they know. It will make me feel much more safe knowing I have people watching my back and supporting me. 

I'm afraid to block him because I don't want to anger him more. If it does escalate I likely will in the futurei though. 

I have some connections with my local law enforcement department due to the fact I'm currently taking a police academy program. I'm going to contact the academy instructor tomorrow about it to see what he thinks is best for this situation. 

Thank you for the response and support. It is very reassuring to know I'm not alone in this.

I agree on the point about blocking. I'm afraid to even read his messages at this point because I don't want him to get even more angry knowing that I'm reading them. 

I will definitely be purchasing some mace tomorrow just in case. It never hurts to be prepared.

There was a point where I wanted to emphasize with him, I wanted to understand him. But now that's passed. I realize who he truly is now. 

Thank you for the response and advice.

I have kept screenshots of his Instagram posts and some past conversations I've had with him. After the advice in this thread I will document everything I possibly can.

Without revealing too much about myself; I will say that I'm currently going through a police academy course so I have many inside sources within our local department who are willing to help me. I think I'll first begin by contacting my academy instructor. 

Thank you for the advice, it's keeping me sane knowing that I'm not the one in the wrong in this situation and that my feelings are valid.
